name: Hydrogen Gas Evolution Apparatus (Zinc + Acid)
semanticDescription: NCERT Class 10 Chemistry Ch 2 Activity 2.1 (Fig 2.1) laboratory-grade Hydrogen Gas Evolution apparatus demonstrating reaction of granulated zinc with dilute sulphuric acid. Features dual presentation collections: Hydrogen_Apparatus_Full (complete setup with clamped Erlenmeyer conical flask on heavy retort stand, two-hole rubber cork, deeply submerged thistle funnel establishing liquid trap seal, zinc granules with effervescent micro-bubble stream, bent glass delivery tube, soap solution trough with rising buoyant iridescent hydrogen bubbles, and lit test candle) and Hydrogen_Apparatus_Section (longitudinal cutaway revealing cork bore channels, liquid seal safety principle, effervescent reaction boundary layer, gas flow migration arrows inside delivery tube, Zn + H2SO4 -> ZnSO4 + H2 reaction plaque, and acoustic pop-sound combustion explosion dynamics with detonation shockwave rings).
simplifications: Effervescent bubbling shown as clustered micro-spheres nucleating on zinc surfaces.
Soap bubbles shown as iridescent thin-film spheres rising buoyantly from trough due to lower density of H2.
Section view demonstrates acoustic pop-sound combustion dynamics at the test candle interface.

materials.look: Bluish-white lustrous crystalline zinc metallic pieces
Clear aqueous liquid acid solution with effervescing bubbles
